title: Fertility Consultation Schedule
content: Consultation dates available: March 15-20, April 5-10. Prefer weekdays. Dr. Emily Harris mentioned the importance of a personalized approach due to our unique situation. Questions to ask: What are the success rates for IUI and IVF for lesbian couples? What legal considerations do we need to be aware of? Are there any recommended dietary or lifestyle changes prior to treatment?

title: Family Planning Notes
content: Discussed with Alex about the desire to start a family. Reviewed several fertility clinics and decided on Rainbow Fertility Care for their expertise with LGBT couples. Medical notes: Alex has a family history of twins, which could influence fertility treatment options. We need to discuss the implications of this with the clinic.
